name: HydrogenSplat
note: Brand tokens. Dark is the primary theme (camera-body black); light is for docs and print.

type.display: Michroma (Google Fonts, OFL) — wordmark and headings, uppercase, tracking +0.12em
type.body: Archivo (Google Fonts, OFL) — UI and running text
type.data: IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts, OFL) — metrics, px/mm values, commands

mark.meaning: Four slats = the four views of a capture (two stereo eyes each on two stems); their vertical offset is parallax. The red ellipse is one Gaussian splat, and the camera's record tally.
mark.clear_space: one slat width (9/120 of the mark) on every side
